name: Estonian Entrepreneurship University of Applied Sciences
summary: Tallinn applied-sciences university (EUAS Mainor) with English-taught bachelor's in business innovation, AI software and game design.

ib.text: No IB points or subjects are asked: send the IB Diploma and transcript, a motivation letter and an English test, then an online interview. An IB Diploma does not waive the English test.

apply.via: EUAS online application and video interview

programmes.name: Creativity and Business Innovation
programmes.about: Prepares entrepreneurs, product or service managers and business executives to build and run innovative ventures, with modules in business management, start-ups, research methods and an internship.
programmes.selectionNote: No entrance exam: documents, a motivation letter and an online video interview on entrepreneurship and innovation. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

family.name: Creativity and Business Innovation
family.differs: Studied in Tallinn only, at the standard fee.

programmes.name: Creativity and Business Innovations (Joint Programme)
programmes.about: The same business-innovation degree, studied across Tallinn, Vilnius University of Applied Sciences in Lithuania and the Polytechnic Institute of Porto in Portugal; the page lists the next admission as autumn 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: No entrance exam: documents, a motivation letter and an online video interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

family.name: Creativity and Business Innovation
family.differs: Study in three countries with partner universities; lower tuition.

programmes.name: Artificial Intelligence Driven Software Technologies and Entrepreneurship
programmes.about: Goes beyond classical computer science: you manage AI-assisted software development, build market-ready platforms in agile sprints and learn privacy by design, with modules in data analysis, entrepreneurship and maths.
programmes.selectionNote: No entrance exam: documents, a motivation letter and an online video interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Game Design and Development
programmes.about: Skills to develop mobile and PC games and start a games company; you specialise in game graphics or software development, with game jams and lectures from industry professionals.
programmes.selectionNote: No entrance exam: documents, a motivation letter and an online video interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: EU citizens pay a study-year commencement fee of €500 on top of the annual tuition, with the first year paid in full once admitted.
Teaching runs Monday to Wednesday each week, and the main campus is in Tallinn.
Tuition is lower for EU citizens than for non-EU students: the pages show €7,820 to €7,880 a year against €8,320 to €8,380.
